definition: a person who amuses others with silly behavior
description: A circus ring filmed from the dark audience seats. An elephant stands on a low round pedestal in a beam of light. Beside it stands a clown in a yellow and purple polka-dot costume with a bright orange wig, huge yellow shoes and a white painted face, next to a man in a dark red suit. A big dark cloth drops over the elephant and hides it completely; the clown throws both arms up in the air towards the audience. When the cloth is pulled away, a white tiger is sitting on the pedestal instead. The clown lies down on the sawdust beside the tiger with its legs in the air while the audience films on their phones.

taps.phrase: to sit next to the clown

fr.answer: Il est assis à côté du clown.
phrases: être assis à côté du clown
fr.question: Où le tigre est-il assis ?
